item.title: Blood for Blood Sign to Roadrunner + Drop “You’re Gonna Have to Kill Me,” The First New Song In 21 Years
item.description: ROADRUNNER SIGNS LEGENDARY BOSTON HARDCORE BAND BLOOD FOR BLOOD BAND SHARES “YOU’RE GONNA HAVE TO KILL ME” — ITS FIRST SINGLE IN TWO DECADES — LISTEN ROADRUNNER RECORDS is thrilled to announce the signing Boston hardcore institution BLOOD FOR BLOOD. Since 1994, Blood for Blood have quietly achieved their rightful place in the hardcore pantheon, thanks to an all-out punk and hardcore assault delivered with metallic precision, laced with venomous swagger and spiked with a sarcastic sense of humor.
